title: In good heart
creator_credit: Campbell Harper Films and Henry Cooper
brief_description: A description of the farming year in Scotland as seen in the lives of four farmers in the Border country, Ayrshire, the Highlands and Angus, and a reminder of the help received by farmers from various research institutes in their efforts to improve livestock and keep the land in the best possible condition.
